title: Concept
description: A canonical definition of a thing. Dictionary entries that establish shared vocabulary.

type.description: Must be 'concept' for all dictionary entries.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: The canonical name of the concept.

aliases.description: Synonyms and alternate names for this concept.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this concept was first recorded.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent update.

superseded_by.description: ID of the concept that replaces this one (used when status is 'deprecated').

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.

related.description: IDs of related concepts (informal association; use transforms for formal relationships).

discussion.description: ID of the primary Discussion artifact anchored to this concept.

references.description: External citations (URLs, paper titles, book references).
